stages.name: sigmoid4_vec
stages.description: Q8.8 -> clamp[-4,4) -> addr=x+1024 -> Q0.16 ROM output.
notes: Best first stage for cocotb bit-exact verification.
Should match RTL clamp, ROM address, and Q0.16 output exactly.

stages.name: ew_update_vec4
stages.description: State update s_new = lam*s_prev + (1-lam)*u with SRAM timing.
notes: Must align lam Q0.16 -> Q8.8 truncation, one_minus, SRAM read latency, and write-back address.

stages.name: top_mac_plus_bias_fifo_sigmoid_ew_gate
stages.description: SSM post-dt path including bias, sigmoid, EW update, and gate.
notes: Good integration target after sigmoid4_vec and ew_update_vec4 pass.

stages.name: reuse_mamba_block_top
stages.description: Block-level top around shared MAC fabric.
notes: Use only after in_proj and SSM subpaths are individually validated.
Current hardware out_proj is still stub, so final y compare may be partial.
